h: Trump reportedly lashes out at Norway after missing the Nobel Peace Prize
p: US President Donald Trump has reportedly used harsh language about Norway after not winning the Nobel Peace Prize, and said Norwegian immigrants are not welcome in the United States. The remarks are drawing wide reaction online.
more: The comments are said to have come in a fresh round of public remarks.
Reactions have poured in from critics and supporters on social media.
